160K likes, 1,385 comments - tamannaahspeaks on October 17, 2026: "Indore, it’s your turn! ❤️✨

After all the love you’ve shown @tamannaahfinejewellery, we’re bringing some of your favourite pieces closer to you. Join us for a super special one day pop-up, where you can discover the collection, try on your favourites and find something that feels like you. Look forward to taking you through the collection personally and guiding you to find pieces you’ll cherish. 

📍 Marriott, Salon 2, Indore
📅 30th October 2026

See you soon, Indore!".
